item.title: Central Eurasia names its 2026 Road to Battlefield winners: Cerberus, WeGlobal AI, and LOOQ
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Cerberus, WeGlobal AI, and LOOQ took the top three spots at the regional final of Road to TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 2026 and will represent Central Eurasia in the Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt in San Francisco this October.

item.title: An Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning comes at a very interesting time
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Sean O'Kane, Kirsten Korosec
item.description: An Anthropic researcher resigned this week, warning in a post on X that the company is “racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives”. The company’s own alignment lead even co-signed the message rather than walking it back. It’s the kind of doomer warning the AI industry has flirted with before, but the timing, with Anthropic reportedly preparing for an IPO, makes it land differently.  On […]

item.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Mark Wahlberg joins Bruce K. Lee at Disrupt to discuss investing, entrepreneurship, healthcare, wellness, and building businesses.

item.title: Furo’s founders left Silicon Valley — and it’s paying off
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: The three 28-year-old founders behind energy startup Furo moved from Silicon Valley and back to Germany, and yet secured $4 million in funding from mostly U.S. backers.

item.title: India’s Pocket FM doubles revenue run rate to $500M as AI powers 93% of audio content
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Pocket FM uses AI to produce 99% of its new content, helping make content production about 80 times cheaper.

item.title: Bending Spoons to buy collaboration tools maker Miro for $1.36B, 90% less than its 2022 valuation
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Bending Spoons is buying Miro for $1.36 billion, a huge dip in valuation for the workplace collaboration startup, which was valued at $17.5 billion in late 2021.

item.title: Maven Robotics wants to steal your robot deployment deal
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Maven Robotics emerged from stealth today with a $100 million Series A and active deployments.

item.title: Google signs its biggest rice-methane carbon credit deal with Indian startup Mitti Labs
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The four-year agreement will cover rice farms across three Indian states, reaching about 100,000 hectares at peak delivery.

item.title: Defense tech Mach Industries doubles valuation to $3.7B in 3 months
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The buzzy startup raised another $600 million in a Series C extension round, bringing the total of the round to $900 million.

item.title: Harvey hits $15.5B valuation, months after reaching $11B
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The legal AI startup and VC darling has nearly doubled its valuation in nine months.

item.title: Uber invests $10M in Indian fleet operator Carrum at $168M valuation
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Carrum Mobility operates about 5,100 vehicles in India and is Uber's largest fleet partner for its premium Uber Black service in the country.

item.title: Sequoia doubles down on Cymphony as AI agents create new enterprise security risks
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Cymphony gives security teams a single view of employees, AI agents, and other nonhuman identities, including the systems and sensitive data they can access.

item.title: CloudNC raises $20M to automate manufacturing’s most pressing bottlenecks
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: U.K.-based manufacturing software startup CloudNC announced Wednesday a $20 million Series B extension round, bringing its lifetime total raised amount to $128 million.

item.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Cognition's valuation multiple is higher than Cursor's was before selling to SpaceX.

item.title: Nuclear startup Bluecore Energy raises $50M seed round, just two months after launch
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Bluecore Energy announced Tuesday an oversubscribed $50 million seed round — just months after raising a $10 million pre-seed and coming out of stealth.
